verdict.rationale: Mintlify's docs offer a web editor as an alternative to Git for content changes (mintlify-docs-1, mintlify-docs-60). Editor changes become pull requests that users can preview, approve and merge without leaving the editor (mintlify-docs-12, mintlify-docs-25), and the editor works against the same repository (mintlify-docs-13), so edits flow into the shared git source of truth. Missing for 10: an explicit description of the editor as a visual/WYSIWYG interface suited to non-technical users, detail on how editor commits and branches sync with the repo, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
